caveats: Previously inspected35 development cases, not a new blinded test.
Independent MiVOLO is evaluation only; fixed recipe, no tuning against its gradients.
Six diagnostic cases plus remaining29 confirmation, final recipe chosen before results.
Two-target fitting differs from historical batch4 and live sequential fitting; compare same-budget teacher control.
Pseudo-age head ending at75 provides no80/90 calibration.
Classifier objective alone does not guarantee natural elderly skin.

manual_review.method: Single reviewer, visible routes; selected full faces and native256 crops, not a blinded study.
findings: Explicit targets improve elderly appearance in some cases but do not resolve smooth reconstruction or etched skin.
64376 has shared age74.3 but independent age53.1; proxy agreement is not guaranteed.
60148 and61908 show eye/mouth/identity changes; original fine details in67140 remain simplified.

decision.reason: High-age SFace drop exceeds0.02 in both fixed six and remaining29; native naturalness improvement not confirmed.
